preconditions.description: The input text must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ('tree fiddy' in text.lower() or '3.50' in text.lower() or 'three fifty' in text.lower())
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if the input text contains the phrase 'tree fiddy', '3.50', or 'three fifty' (case-insensitive), indicating the presence of the Loch Ness Monster.
